SessionOpenParams.description: Runs the same execution admission as ACP session/load without replaying ACP history. Read UI history through projectUIOpening and subscribe from its cut. requestId scopes loadingCancel to this caller's wait.

SessionLoadingCancelParams.description: Cancels loading waits on this connection, optionally restricted to one session.open requestId; never cancels the session's running turn.

SessionApprovalGrant.description: One allowance that lets a session's tool run without asking. A session grant ends with the session; an always grant belongs to the session's actor under its policy.

oneOf.description: Profile approval invalidation only. Re-read profile.decisions.list through its authorized ingress; no decision content or identifier is carried.

SessionViewParams.description: Reads one session's recorded conversation without opening it: nothing is restored, locked or written, so a session this build cannot continue stays viewable.

SessionViewNotice.description: Why the record could only be partly read. Present when the ledger itself is damaged or in a format this build cannot decode; the rows that were decoded safely are still returned.

SessionViewResult.description: A presentation-only preview. No integrity verification or execution authority is implied.

timeline.description: Never busy: opState is null and generation is 1, because no live session stands behind it.

scan.description: Present when the read stopped at a scan budget: the timeline covers only the rows fromSeq..throughSeq. A session over budget is read from its newest row backwards, so rows before fromSeq are the ones not shown.

SessionReadToolDetailParams.description: Read bounded UTF-8 chunks of the recorded tool call and matching result for one session.

SessionReadToolDetailResult.description: A bounded base64 chunk of the UTF-8 JSON object {call: ToolCall, result?: ToolResult}. The daemon authenticates session access before reading ledger events.

data.description: Canonical standard base64 for at most 262144 response bytes.

SessionDeliverablesParams.description: Read one page of present-tool deliverable sources whose result was recorded after afterSeq, without the full UI projection.

afterSeq.description: Exclusive ledger seq; pass the previous page's nextAfterSeq, or its upto to read later changes.

SessionDeliverableSource.description: One present call and the result the UI projection pairs with it on the session's main lane. turnId is the projection turn whose seq range holds the call; structured is the result's structured data as recorded, absent when the result has none.

SessionDeliverablesResult.description: Items in ascending resultSeq after the requested afterSeq, at most limit of them and 262144 bytes of JSON. upto is the ledger seq the page covers; nextAfterSeq, equal to upto, is present only when more items remain.

oneOf.description: A turn's file changes were put back, partly put back, or refused because a file changed after the turn.
Tool sources a turn started without because they were still connecting, such as a newly enabled MCP server.

argumentRecovery.description: Core's argument rejection fact. Render failed attempts in one collapsed technical record.

purpose.description: Backend-owned decision purpose; mode choices and factual questions retain their semantics.

prefixGrant.description: Present on a pending shell approval when Core offers to allow every command that starts with these tokens for the rest of the session. Clients render the tokens exactly as given and answer with the decision option allow_prefix_session; they never derive a prefix themselves.

runsProjectCode.description: The offered prefix can run project-defined scripts, hooks or build code. Display only; included in the decision subject digest.

grantScopes.description: Present on a pending tool approval: the scopes the always-allow options would store, as Core computed them. Clients show them beside those options and never derive them.

origin.description: Present when Core knows who asked: the package that owns the tool, the agent role of a delegated session and the MCP server a tool came from. Display only; no field is an authorization input.

reconcile.description: Present when Core asks whether a tool call whose result never arrived actually ran (decision owner core/unknown-outcome): the tool it asks about. The allowed options mean it ran; rejected means it did not.

rewrite.description: Present when an approval_request hook rewrote the summary or context: the platform's own summary and the hook sources that rewrote it.

providerCallMs.description: Provider invocation wall time through adapter and capture cleanup; not the enclosing turn or provider service time.

prepareMs.description: Provider-local preparation before capture begins; excludes upstream context preparation.

captureMs.description: Union of blocking trace-capture intervals, including cleanup. Overlaps the other intervals; do not add again.

dispatchMs.description: Offset from provider entry to the first observed transport dispatch, after request capture. Absent without a transport observation.

firstOutputMs.description: Offset from provider entry to first decoded caller-visible text, thinking or tool output.

outputMs.description: Wall time from first visible output to observing the terminal outcome, including intervening local work.

finalizeMs.description: Wall time from terminal observation to adapter and trace cleanup completion.

compactAt.description: Context tokens at which threshold compaction fires; present only while autoCompact is on.

argumentRecovery.description: Bounded diagnostic attempts without a tool-call node (nested/announced validation refusals). Full history stays in the ledger.

verification.description: Trusted Core completion-check recovery outcome; completion does not imply a passing verification.

slots.description: Live registry status/action fills outside transcript indices. In patches, a supplied array replaces all known live slots.

pendingInputs.description: Authoritative pending inbox order at this projection cut, including next-step steer inputs.

yolo.description: Current session full-access mode, independent of the projected history cut. Omitted by older servers.

slots.description: Live registry status/action fills outside transcript indices. In patches, a supplied array replaces all known live slots.

pendingInputs.description: Full replacement of next-turn inbox order, including an empty array when drained. Omission preserves known input for older-server compatibility.

yolo.description: Current session full-access mode. Omission preserves the client's known mode for older-server compatibility.

executionRevision.description: Last revision affecting execution; presentation-only CAS still increments revision.

credentialIssue.description: Read-only availability reason. Missing or unreadable credentials exclude this account from new-session routes; no credential values are returned.

ArtifactReadParams.description: Read one bounded byte range from a content-addressed artifact. Session and lane are authorization targets, not caller identity; the daemon authenticates that scope independently.

range.description: One RFC 7233 bytes range. Multiple ranges are unsupported.

ArtifactReadResult.description: A bounded base64 JSON-RPC artifact response or a fixed, non-secret failure.

base64.description: Canonical standard base64 for at most 1 MiB of response bytes.
Canonical standard base64 for at most 1 MiB of response bytes.

model.description: The model served by providers.model-adapter; valid only beside it.
